decision_summary: Approve the first executable QIF baseline.
rationale: Need Validation and Project Charter preceded implementation; validator passes; Guardian guardrail blocks activity-count-as-quality misuse.
recommendation: Proceed to self-review and retrospective after recording validation evidence.
expected_user_reaction: They can inspect docs, schema, sample, and validator without relying on hidden assumptions.
artifact_change_recommendations: In a future slice, add real organization case corpora and negative fixtures.
organization_change_recommendations: Use QIF package validation as the default acceptance gate for new Quality Intents.
